note: Fixed before any model was evaluated. The core labels and budgets were chosen from patient-level support in train/val and in the planned subsets; they are never revised from model performance or test results.

labels.masking_policy: a label with zero positive training patients in a run's subset is masked out of the loss and marked unsupported for that run; aggregates that would include it are reported as incomplete

repeats.pretraining: independent per repeat; each checkpoint reused across that repeat's budgets and by both pretrained arms

pretrain.folds: train only (1-8), all recordings, labels unused

arms.scratch: encoder randomly initialised, all weights trained (primary)
arms.finetune: encoder from the repeat's JEPA checkpoint, all weights trained (primary)
arms.probe: encoder from the repeat's JEPA checkpoint, frozen; head trained (secondary)

downstream.head: mean pool -> linear (12 outputs)
downstream.lr_selection: per arm, on validation, at repeat 0 and budget 0.10; then frozen

af_operating_point.output: AFIB from the main multi-label model
af_operating_point.cohort: primary: exclude unknown-rhythm records and any record carrying AFLT (incl. AFIB+AFLT)
af_operating_point.calibration: none in study v1 (calibration evaluated separately, later)

evaluation.headline: core macro AUROC, recording level, full eligible rhythm-task cohort of test fold 10
evaluation.bootstrap: paired patient-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples; per repeat and for the repeat mean (shared patient resample); repeat-to-repeat spread reported separately
